newsitem.title: UK: Russia has set aside full amount to cover MinFins.
newsitem.headline: Russia has set aside full amount to cover MinFins.

text.p: Russia's Finance Ministry said on Friday it had put aside enough money to honour all its obligations for frozen MinFin bonds.
"The ministry of finance has set aside an amount for the full repayment of oustanding obligations under the bonds that have been frozen," the ministry said in a statement released in London.
At least $74 million worth of the bonds are known to have been frozen by the proescutor general after they had been discovered to have been stolen.
The issue has severely undermined international confidence in the bonds, which are issued in dollars though custody must be in Russia.
The statement said the government had recommended that the Interior Ministry and State Presecutor not use their rights under existing provisions of the criminal code to freeze bonds.
The government has demanded proposals to change the legislation which has led to the current problem, by Novbember 25.
On Thursday, deputy finance minister Mikhail Kasyanov said he was confident the problem, which has been hanging over the market for much of this year, would be resolved.
